about: The starting point for every restaurant type: each weight's prior (the model's guess before it sees the restaurant's data) and how sure it is. effect_pct is the % change in orders for the factor (per unit where a unit is named), by channel; 'all' applies to every channel unless a channel has its own number, and a channel not named gets 0. sd is on the log scale (0.10 = about +/- 10%). Common-sense starting points, written by hand: not taken from any synthetic data. halal.json, cafe.json and takeaway.json only list what differs.

weekday_pct.reason: Weekends drive eating out; early in the week is quiet. Relative to an average day, before allowing for shorter or longer opening hours.

season.reason: No assumption about the time of year for a general restaurant: the data decides.

trend.reason: No assumption about growth or decline.

weekday_summer.reason: Only used if the back-test shows weekdays behave differently in summer; no assumption about how.

bank_holiday.reason: A free day means more leisure eating.

bh_eve.reason: The night before a long weekend can be a little busier, but not reliably.

bh_after.reason: People stay in after a long weekend.

xmas_week.reason: 27 to 30 December: many people away or eating leftovers.

nye.reason: Parties pull both ways: busy for some, empty for others.

new_year.reason: A quiet, tired day at home.

school_holiday.reason: No clear direction for a general restaurant.

payday_window.reason: More spending money on payday and the 2 days after.

clock_change_fwd.reason: The lost hour is already in the opening-hours offset; no other assumption.

clock_change_back.reason: The extra hour is already in the opening-hours offset; no other assumption.

diwali.reason: A festive evening out for many London families.

ramadan_1_10.reason: Little effect expected outside a Muslim customer base.

ramadan_11_20.reason: Little effect expected outside a Muslim customer base.

ramadan_last10.reason: Little effect expected outside a Muslim customer base.

eid_fitr_d1.reason: A celebration day in the area lifts trade a little.

temp_warm.reason: Warm weather brings people out and away from delivery.

temp_hot.reason: Too hot for a hot meal.

rain_lunch.unit: per mm in open hours 11:00 to 15:00 (capped at 10)
rain_lunch.reason: Rain swaps going out for delivery.

rain_dinner.unit: per mm in open hours 17:00 to 22:00 (capped at 10)
rain_dinner.reason: Rain swaps going out for delivery.

sunshine.unit: per hour above the month's normal

football_during.unit: per match unit (importance x relevance x share of the window open)
football_during.reason: People watch at home with food.

cricket_during.reason: No assumption for a general restaurant; no fixtures feed yet.

cricket_after.reason: No assumption for a general restaurant; no fixtures feed yet.

venue.unit: per 10,000 people at 0 km (fading with distance)

disruption.reason: Strikes keep commuters away and push some to delivery.

deal.reason: A typical modest lift while a deal runs.

log_price_index.unit: elasticity of orders to the menu price index
log_price_index.reason: Restaurant elasticities are usually between -0.3 and -1.

dispersion.reason: Orders vary a bit more than pure chance (negative binomial); a weak guess the data quickly overrides.

football.reason: England matches are watched widely; club matches only count for the restaurant's own teams.

cricket.reason: No assumption for a general restaurant.
